# Brandise
> Creative and technology agency serving US businesses: brand design, video editing, marketing, social media, AI automation and web app development. Tagline: Where Brands Rise. 3+ years of industry experience.

## Services
- [Brand & Visual Design](/brand-design) — Logo, brand identity, packaging, UI/UX and creative assets for US businesses.
- [Web App Development](/web-app-development) — Custom websites, SaaS platforms, dashboards and modern web applications.
- [Video Editing & Motion](/video-editing) — Short-form Reels/TikToks/Shorts, YouTube long-form, motion graphics and ad edits.
- [Performance Marketing](/digital-marketing) — Meta, Google and TikTok ad campaigns engineered for ROI and lead generation.
- [Social Media Management](/social-media) — Content strategy, scheduling, organic growth and analytics across all platforms.
- [AI & Workflow Automation](/ai-automation) — Custom AI chatbots, lead capture automations, CRM integrations and workflows.
